integrity: The exact plane-wave map date and conference provenance were verified from the conference record. A full 2012 Ikeda horseshoe article and a full 2019 article explicitly approximating Ikeda invariant measures were inspected at implication level. The radial law was reconstructed directly from the map and its algebra replayed with the packaged exact checker; no numerical simulation is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes 0<u<1; conservative and expansive variants are outside scope.
The result determines radial pushforwards and a mean–variance disk but not angular distributions, entropy, Lyapunov exponents, or physical-measure uniqueness.
The 1985 exact-map article was inspected through substantial preview material rather than a complete readable copy.
An equivalent geometric balance could occur under optical-power terminology in unindexed literature.
title: Universal radial distribution law and sharp mean–variance disk for the Ikeda map
